newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit quiet vs dollar, active against Sing.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit quiet vs dollar, active against Sing.

text.p: The ringgit was tightly traded against the dollar but retreated against the Singapore dollar in largely uneventful trading, dealers said.
The ringgit/Sing cross was active, with profit taking emerging after it failed to move beyond 0.5800 Singapore dollar, they said.

"Dollar/ringgit (was) mainly dictated by ringgit/Singapore dollar which failed the 0.5800 level, causing profit taking," said research house MMS International in its market commentary. The diplomatic row between Singapore and Malaysia over remarks by Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew totally ignored.
"Let them talk it out. It doesn't affect us," said a dealer at a Malaysian bank.
At the 1000 GMT Kuala Lumpur close, ringgit was at 2.4758/63 a dollar against 2.4750/60 at its Wednesday local closing.
The ringgit was also at 0.5780/90 Singapore dollar against 0.5800/0.5790 previously.
Lee, who had described Malaysia's Johor state as "notorious", late on Thursday apologised for the offence caused by his statement.
